entries.name: Dynamic RefSet refresh
entries.description: After an accepted RefSet update, stop the stale subset schedule so the next combination round is generated from the updated RefSet.

entries.name: Two-tier quality/diversity RefSet
entries.description: Maintain b1 high-quality solutions and b2 diversity-oriented solutions with separate admission criteria.

entries.name: Partial max-min RefSet rebuilding
entries.description: At stagnation, retain the quality tier and refill the diversity tier from a fresh diversified population by sequential max-min selection.

entries.name: Minimum diversity threshold
entries.description: Require a candidate for the quality tier to remain at least th_dist away from the already retained quality representatives.

entries.name: Representative Subset Types 1-4
entries.description: Generate all pairs, representative augmented triples and quadruples, then nested best-i subsets for i=5..b, while avoiding repeated subsets.
entries.formula: \begin{aligned}\mathcal S_1&=\{S\subseteq R:|S|=2\},\\\mathcal S_2&=\{\operatorname{AugmentBest}(S):S\in\mathcal S_1\},\\\mathcal S_3&=\{\operatorname{AugmentBest}(S):S\in\mathcal S_2\},\\\mathcal S_4&=\{\{r_1,\ldots,r_i\}:5\le i\le b\}\end{aligned}

entries.name: Three-tier good-generator RefSet
entries.description: Requires g(x), the best offspring quality historically generated with each reference solution, and therefore a generator-performance memory contract not present in the generic five-method API.
entries.formula: Reviewed faithfully as a three-tier generator-performance design; deferred until per-reference offspring-performance memory is represented explicitly.

entries.name: Hash-assisted duplication control
entries.description: The literature gives representation-specific hashing, including a permutation hash; a universal hash with correct equality semantics cannot be manufactured generically.
entries.formula: Reviewed as a representation-specific acceleration of duplicate checks; deferred rather than pretending that one generic hash is collision-safe and semantically complete.

entries.name: Variable-cardinality specialized combination
entries.description: Advanced combination methods depend on representation and problem structure rather than one universal operator.
entries.formula: Reviewed from the advanced-design literature and deferred to representation-specific composition contracts.

entries.name: Binary-variable specialized combination
entries.description: Binary combination semantics require a binary decision representation and cannot be imposed on continuous, permutation and mixed solutions.
entries.formula: Reviewed as a specialized binary combination family and deferred to a binary representation contract.

entries.name: Explicit evaluated-solution memory
entries.description: Useful when objective evaluations are expensive; requires stable solution identity or representation-specific hashing and a bounded memory policy.
entries.formula: Reviewed as explicit memory for avoiding repeated expensive evaluations; deferred until solution identity and memory-bounding semantics are explicit.

entries.name: Deep Scatter Search / Path Relinking integration
entries.description: Path Relinking can serve as a combination/intensification mechanism, but a faithful generic integration must connect the existing PR trajectory contracts to Scatter Search subset semantics.
entries.formula: Reviewed as a pool-oriented Scatter Search and Path Relinking integration; deferred to a dedicated typed bridge rather than reduced to a boolean flag.
